blocks.text: Rulebreaker is the eleventh studio album from the German heavy metal band Primal Fear. The album was released on January 22, 2016. It is the first album to feature Francesco Jovino on drums. It also marks the return of original guitarist, Tom Naumann, for his third stint with the band, making it the band's first album with three guitar players.

Bittersweet World is the third studio album by American singer-songwriter Ashlee Simpson. It was released in the United States on April 22, 2008. The project is her final release through Geffen Records.
